paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Financial QA-1 evaluation.
model_annotation: The bar chart titled "QA-1" presents a comparative evaluation of three Korean language models on a financial question-answering task, as described in the paper "RedWhale: An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining." The vertical axis lists the models: "Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B," "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0," and "RedWhale (our)," arranged from top to bottom. The horizontal axis represents performance scores, segmented into three categories: "Correct" (dark purple), "Partially Correct" (medium blue), and "Incorrect" (light blue), as indicated in the legend. Each model's performance is shown as a stacked horizontal bar, with the total length summing to 1.0. For "Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B," the bar is divided into 0.88 (Correct), 0.08 (Partially Correct), and 0.04 (Incorrect). For "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0," the bar shows 0.96 (Correct), 0 (Partially Correct), and 0.04 (Incorrect). Similarly, "RedWhale (our)" has 0.96 (Correct), 0 (Partially Correct), and 0.04 (Incorrect). The chart visually highlights that both EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 and RedWhale achieve higher correct response rates than Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, with no partially correct responses for the two top-performing models. The bars are sorted in descending order of correct performance, and the "RedWhale (our)" model is explicitly labeled to denote it as the authors' proposed model.
